case.subject: Automating HR and Consultant Onboarding
case.problem: Converteo's human resources and administrative teams faced time-consuming, multi-departmental administrative tasks when integrating new consultants.
case.workflow: The firm deployed agents that orchestrate the onboarding journey—specifically handling tool access, initial training, and contract verification—by querying and summarizing internal documentation.
case.result: The agent automates the orchestration of the onboarding journey, resulting in reduced time lost for HR teams and a smoother experience for new hires.
case.result_basis: Company-reported case study published by Google Cloud.
case.measurement_context: Qualitative improvement in administrative efficiency and reduction in time-consuming tasks previously managed manually across departments.
case.source_quote: un agent orchestre désormais l'ensemble du parcours : accès aux outils, formation initiale, vérifications contractuelles, etc. Le gain
case.limitation: The agent's effectiveness relies on the quality of documentation and existing system integrations; human oversight is required for sensitive verification steps.
case.listener_action: Map your most repetitive administrative onboarding or HR task, identify the documentation bottlenecks, and test whether an AI agent can reliably summarize and trigger the necessary next-step notifications.
case.availability: Generally available on Google Cloud Platform; requires configuration of document connectors and agent workflows.
